questions.prompt: Which pitfall matters when applying “Sparse matrix operations”?
options: Catch every exception and silently replace failed results with zeros.
Do not assume every view owns independent memory or that contiguous() is free; both aliasing and copies matter.

Treat successful imports as proof that the full model and evaluation pipeline are correct.
questions.answer_key: Do not assume every view owns independent memory or that contiguous() is free; both aliasing and copies matter.
